subject: nexora.in loads in 6.8 seconds on mobile - here is how to fix it
body:
Hi there,

I was looking at nexora.in this morning and ran it through a few speed tests. Your homepage takes about 6.8 seconds to load on a mid-range phone over 4G, mostly because of uncompressed hero images and render-blocking scripts. Studies consistently show that visitors start leaving after 3 seconds, so this is probably costing you enquiries.

At Digiwave Solutions in Pune, we have helped more than 60 B2B companies bring their load times under 2 seconds and improve organic traffic by 30-40% within a quarter. We can do a free website audit and share a short report on the top five fixes, with no obligation.

Would you be open to a 15-minute call this week? I can work around your schedule.

Best,
Rahul Wagh
Business Development | Digiwave Solutions
+91 99608 12345
